name: Lost in the Woods
source:
You were only out for a walk, but now you find yourself face-to-face with the forest that’s lingered in your mind for years – silent, vast, and strangely inviting.

[From [url=https://milliexoxo.itch.io/lost-in-the-woods]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你本来只是出去散步，但现在你发现自己面对面地面对着多年来一直萦绕在你脑海中的森林——寂静、广阔、奇异地诱人。

[来自[url=https://milliexoxo.itch.io/lost-in-the-woods]Itch.io[/url]]
